rescaleCharacter: rescale a list of torch tensors to 0-255 byte range by normalizing with min-max scaling
pickle_dump_train_test: pickle dump train and test datasets to pickle files for Assamese handwriting recognition
load_character_data: load character image data from tmp python files using exec for train and test splits
split_train_test_writers: split 45 writers into 36 train and 9 test writers for Assamese handwriting dataset
normalize_character_tensors: normalize character tensor lists by computing global min and max across all tensors
